write_up: Your resume tells a common story: product design at Brightpath Studio and Loop Fitness, followed by a current barista role. The design work is named, but the results and choices behind it are mostly missing. For product design jobs, that makes it difficult to distinguish your work from other applicants’.

The line about creating Loop Fitness’s first design system in Figma is the best model: it names a concrete deliverable and the tool. Your current role accounts for the time after Loop, though a recruiter may still wonder whether you’ve continued designing.

Let’s start with the Loop booking flow. Add a design choice you made and, where you can substantiate it, what changed. Then give the usability tests and Brightpath projects the same treatment. Your portfolio may show more, but the resume needs enough to get a recruiter there.
